title: Beacon module.json
description: Exceptions to convention for one module folder.

output.description: Output this module belongs to (overrides include globs).

onConflict.description: Merge policy for items that collide with other modules.

paths.description: Module-relative glob -> pack folder; the file name is kept.

hooks.description: Script hooks: module-relative function path (no extension) -> priority, lower first.

itemTextures.description: item_texture.json entries: short name -> module-relative texture path.

terrainTextures.description: terrain_texture.json entries: short name -> module-relative texture path.

packRoots.description: Module-relative folders whose contents are pack-relative paths.

conflicts.description: Module-relative glob -> merge policy; overrides onConflict.

autoTextures.description: Derive texture entries from sibling pngs.
